analysis:
Documentation-only change: docs/reference/configuration.md adds one row at head line 414 describing DARKBLOOM_TTFT_GDN_BLOCKED, read in libs/mlx-swift-lm/Libraries/MLXLLM/Models/GatedDelta.swift (GatedDeltaPrefill.mode/kernel). The row describes kernel selection for Gated DeltaNet prefill in qwen3_5 family models. The default is a probe that keeps the four-row kernel only when it is bit-exact with gated_delta_step. Forced kernels skip that check and are documented as A/B only. The variable is read once per process and is documented as not forwarded to LaunchAgents, so installed daemons keep the default probe. Base units (lines 1-518) were examined as surrounding context.

Threat relevance: forcing a non-verified kernel could alter outputs (T-007/T-012 class: a provider serving manipulated outputs). This is an operator-controlled local setting, and the operator is already an adversary (ADV-001) with full process-environment control, so it adds no new capability. The row does not touch encryption, attestation, authorization or the prefix-cache gate (T-041).

It is worth noting that the row is explicitly about TTFT and prefill timing. Kernel choice could shift TTFT. However, the SEC-035 timing oracle concerns cache hit versus miss, not kernel speed, so it is unaffected.

The actual GatedDelta.swift implementation was not supplied, so the probe's fail-safe behavior is a documentation claim only. Verifying it is a correctness question for the SDK, not a security regression shown in this PR. No findings.
